Type: large southwestern area rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, bohemian, rustic
Materials: woven pile with vintage distressed finish
Colors: deep blue, rust orange, ivory, red accents
Shape: large rectangle, rows of medallion diamonds, small scattered motifs, patterned border, low pile, bold visual weight
Feel: rich, warm, earthy
Goes with: dark wood floors, leather, woven baskets, terracotta; bohemian or traditional rooms

product.description: Brighten your room with this beautiful area rug. With a Southwest-inspired design, this rug blends well with several home-decor styles, including Southwestern, contemporary, modern, and vintage, and its blue, orange, and red hues add a splash of color to the room. 7'10" x 11' Polypropylene Frisee Machine made 0.33 Med
